phaseName: Core Apps I: Notes, Calculator, Terminal
goal: Implement three smaller core apps with full behavior and tests: Notes (CRUD persisted), Calculator (arithmetic + keyboard), Terminal (command parser over the shared mock FS).
summary: Phase 4 complete: Notes, Calculator, Terminal apps fully built with unit + UI interaction tests. Step 1 (Notes): useNotes hook with localStorage CRUD (createNote prepends + activates, updateNote sets modifiedAt, deleteNote removes + shifts activeId via pure useEffect — no impure state updater), Notes UI with sidebar (search, list, new-note) + editor. 6 persistence tests + 7 hook CRUD tests (renderHook). Step 2 (Calculator): engine.ts with safe shunting-yard parser (operator precedence, parentheses, decimals, division-by-zero→NaN), Calculator UI with button grid + full keyboard (0-9, operators, Enter, Escape, %, Backspace). 19 engine tests. Step 3 (Terminal): parser.ts with 8 commands over shared mockFS (ls/cd/cat/echo/pwd/mkdir/clear/help + whoami/date, echo > redirect), Terminal UI with history (ArrowUp/Down), Ctrl+L clear, fixed clear bug (was restoring lines after clear). 24 parser tests. Added 15 E2E UI interaction tests (apps-phase4.spec.ts): Notes create/edit/delete/reload-persistence/search, Calculator button+keyboard+Escape+Backspace+precedence, Terminal ls/pwd/cd/history/clear/cat/echo-redirect. Verification: `npx vitest run` → 99 passed; `npx playwright test` → 59 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (59 modules).
